bukhari:2442.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:2442.note: Ibn Umar: a Muslim is the brother of a Muslim; whoever fulfils his brother's need, Allah fulfils his need (checked against the hadith-api eng-bukhari / ara-bukhari editions)

bukhari:5986.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:5986.note: Anas: whoever loves that his provision be expanded and his life prolonged, let him keep the ties of kinship (hadith-api eng/ara-bukhari)

bukhari:6065.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:6065.note: Anas: do not hate one another, do not envy one another, do not turn away from one another, be servants of Allah as brothers (hadith-api eng/ara-bukhari)

bukhari:6116.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:6116.note: Abu Hurayrah: a man asked for advice; the Prophet said 'Do not become angry', repeated (hadith-api eng/ara-bukhari)

tirmidhi:3540.grader: al-Albani (hadith-api reference); at-Tirmidhi: gharib; Zubair Ali Zai: isnad hasan
tirmidhi:3540.note: Anas: O son of Adam, were your sins to reach the clouds of the sky (hadith-api eng/ara-tirmidhi)
